question: Who became India's first badminton world champion in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P. V. Sindhu**__.

__
 
• PV Sindhu becomes the first Indian** Badminton player** to win a gold medal in the World Badminton Championship in 2019.
 
• PV Sindhu became the first Indian woman to claim two Olympic medals after she won a badminton bronze medal in Tokyo2020.
 
• **Other medals of Sindhu**:
 
 
• Rio Olympic silver medal in 2016.
 
• A silver at the Gold Coast Commonwealth Games.
 
• An Asian Games silver at Jakarta.
 
• The BWF World Tour Finals last year.

• Saina Nehwal is an Indian professional badminton singles player.

 
 
• A former world no. 1, she has won over 24 international titles, which includes eleven Superseries titles.
 
• She has represented India three times in the Olympics, winning a bronze medal in her second appearance.
 
• She was awarded Padma Bhushan, Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, and Arjuna Award.
 
 
 
• Jwala Gutta is an Indian professional badminton player.
 
 
• Jwala Gutta was the first badminton player of Indian to qualify for two events in the Olympics–women's doubles with Ponnappa and mixed doubles with V. Diju at London.
 
• She was awarded the Arjuna Award, India's second-highest sporting award for her achievements.
 
 
 
• **KidambiSrikanth **is a famous badminton player in India.
 
 
• In 2018, he has been awarded with the** Padma Shri Award.**
 
• In April 2018, Srikanth became the top-ranked player in the world in badminton.
